cards.answer: Maokai is a tank/support who engages with a targeted dash and root, then disrupts nearby enemies with knockback. He deals magic damage and sustains himself through healing attacks.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance from his engage and approach brush cautiously.

citations.quote: Name: Maokai. Official role tags: Tank, Support.
Maokai dashes to the target enemy while being untargetable, dealing magic damage and briefly rooting them upon arrival.
Enemies near Maokai are also briefly stunned and knocked back.

facts.claim: Maokai is a tank/support who engages with a targeted dash and root, then disrupts nearby enemies with knockback.

citations.quote: Maokai knocks back nearby enemies with a shockwave, dealing magic damage and slowing them.
Periodically, Maokai's next basic attack will heal him for a portion of his maximum health.

facts.claim: He deals magic damage and sustains himself through healing attacks.

cards.priority_reason: Recognizing his engage and disruption helps avoid being caught.
uncertainties: Defensive build focus is inferred from the supplied tank role; item builds and resistance scaling are not supplied.

cards.answer: Sap Magic periodically empowers Maokai's next basic attack to heal him based on his maximum health. Casting abilities, being hit by enemy abilities, and hitting enemy champions or epic monsters with Sapling Toss bring the heal back sooner.
cards.counterplay: Limit unnecessary ability poke and keep him out of attack range when disengaging.

citations.quote: Periodically, Maokai's next basic attack will heal him for a portion of his maximum health.

facts.claim: Sap Magic periodically empowers Maokai's next basic attack to heal him based on his maximum health.

facts.claim: Casting abilities, being hit by enemy abilities, and hitting enemy champions or epic monsters with Sapling Toss bring the heal back sooner.

cards.priority_reason: His recurring healing affects trades and extended fights.

cards.answer: Bramble Smash sends a directional shockwave that deals magic damage and briefly slows enemies hit. Enemies near Maokai are also briefly stunned and knocked back.
cards.counterplay: Keep space around Maokai and sidestep the shockwave when possible.

citations.quote: Maokai sends a shockwave in the target direction that deals magic damage and briefly slows enemies hit.

facts.claim: Enemies near Maokai are also briefly stunned and knocked back.

cards.answer: Twisted Advance is a targeted dash that makes Maokai untargetable during travel, then deals magic damage and roots the target on arrival. He tracks the target if they change locations.
cards.counterplay: Respect his engage range and save attacks or targeted spells until he becomes targetable again.

citations.quote: Maokai dashes to the target enemy while being untargetable, dealing magic damage and briefly rooting them upon arrival.

facts.claim: He tracks the target if they change locations.

cards.priority_reason: His targeted engage and untargetability strongly affect escape and spell timing.

cards.answer: Sapling Toss places a sapling that grants sight, chases nearby visible enemies, and explodes on contact or expiry to deal magic damage and slow nearby enemies. Brush empowers saplings to deal additional damage over time and reveal enemies hit.
cards.counterplay: Approach brush cautiously and move away from allies when a sapling chases you.

citations.quote: Once landed, the Sapling grants sight of its surroundings
until it reacts to the first nearby visible enemy, chasing them for up to 2.5 seconds.
The Sapling explodes upon colliding with an enemy or when it expires, dealing magic damage to nearby enemies, capped at 300 against non-champions, and slowing them by 45% for 2 seconds.

facts.claim: Sapling Toss places a sapling that grants sight, chases nearby visible enemies, and explodes on contact or expiry to deal magic damage and slow nearby enemies.

citations.quote: Saplings thrown into brushes become empowered and will deal double damage to non-minions struck by them over 1.5 seconds.
reveal them for 3 seconds.

facts.claim: Brush empowers saplings to deal additional damage over time and reveal enemies hit.

cards.priority_reason: Saplings threaten brush access and provide information before fights.

cards.answer: Nature's Grasp sends an advancing wall of brambles that accelerates over time, dealing magic damage and rooting enemies hit. Each bramble stops when it hits an enemy champion, and its root lasts longer after traveling farther. Hitting an enemy champion grants Maokai a burst of movement speed that fades.
cards.counterplay: Move out of the wall's path early and be ready for Maokai to follow up.

Each bramble deals magic damage to enemies hit and roots them for a short time based on the bramble's distance travelled.

conflicts.resolution: Omit target maximum-health damage from Sapling Toss. Its qualitative damage, slow, sight, and brush empowerment remain supported.
conflicts.topic: The Sapling Toss summary describes damage based on the target's maximum health, but its detailed formula instead lists base damage with bonus-health and AP scaling.
